Landing.faqTitle: Good to know before the first flake

faq.a: We cover Ottawa, Kanata, Barrhaven, Orleans, Nepean, Gloucester, and Stittsville. Drop your address at booking and we'll confirm a pro is available.
Your card is authorized when you book, but the payment only releases after you approve the before-and-after photos. If it's not cleared, you're not charged.

faq.q: How fast will my driveway be cleared?
faq.a: Overnight snow jobs are targeted to be cleared by 7AM. You'll get a notification the moment your pro is en route and again when the work is verified.

faq.q: Are the pros insured and vetted?
faq.a: Every pro on Capital Clear is identity-verified and reviewed before taking jobs. You see ratings and completed-job counts before you ever book.
